Good service and food - but a slightly messy experience at a grand hotel
Dec 2024 • Family
Amazing staff, quick service and great selection of seafood, sushi, noodles, meat and desserts. We had the December buffet, which I think is a little different than the usual.

Warm lobsters were probably warmed a little too long under a heat lamp which was noticeable on the meat. The cold ones were super. Many sauces to choose from. 

Good medium-sized oysters - just to my taste. The amount of desserts was phenomenal and with a chocolate fountain to the delight of the children.

What we experienced as negative was that it was very messy in the restaurant - very loud noise from a number of larger groups. Since there is free drinking, there were also many who were a little over-refreshed. This is the reason why I do not give full points (at least this time).

Notwithstanding the above, I'd love to make a return visit - the food was great!

Colorado15 contributions

An Amazing Buffet Experience!
Feb 2024 • Couples
I come every year to visit my family down in Can Tho and I’ve stayed and dined at many locations but this was my first Sheraton experience. The breakfast buffet was an experience in itself. The restaurant was very clean, the staff very friendly and the food was exquisite. The variety was endless serving everything from traditional Vietnamese, American, French, and even Indian breakfast. Fresh tender cuts of meat, sushi, pastries, and fresh fruit. There was even a full fresh juice bar. The food was Served hot and fresh and constantly replenished. They have an egg station where I was able to make a customized omelet my way and trust me, I’m very particular. 

A special shout out to our server Man Thoung who was very attentive, friendly, and so accommodating. I wanted fresh mango and there wasn’t any, but he located some and had it cut and served to my table. He also brought endless fresh baby coconut juice until I said “no more”. ;-)
My last day in Vietnam and it was such a wonderful experience…I’ll be back to the Sheraton and to there Saigon Cafe!

Amazing service and fabulous food
Sep 2023 • Family
Qui Bui at the restaurant was very helpful today with excellent service, warm and friendly personality. We received homemade mooncakes, a Vietnamese specialty, as gifts after our seafood buffett dinner. There was so much food! We had our heart’s fill and left with a food coma. The staff here are so mindful and picked up our plates as soon as we were done and requested us to use fresh plates for each of our following servings. Food selection was amazing and restaurant had a great vibe. We were served by another amazing staff Nhi who was very attentive. The restaurant manager checked in on us to see if we were enjoying the food and service and asked us if we had any suggestions if anything needs to be changed or improved.
We had buffet breakfast here in the morning as well which was again fabulous with amazing selection of food from across the globe. Needless to say the morning staff was great too who explained me types of Vietnamaese cuisine. Special mention to Ngan and Tran Nyugen for looking after us. 
We had a great time and surely will come back for more.

Business trip became a Culinary Experience
Jul 2023 • Business
I was staying at Sheraton for a Business trip (Expo for 5 Nights) and had breakfast every morning at Saigon Cafe. I love the ambiance and the sincereness of the staff. 

The food is amazing (high quality) and my favorite is the Parma Ham.

A very special shout out to the restaurant manager Mr. Minh who is very dedicated to his guest and shows us how true hospitality should be.

The first day I met him, I forgot to bring my cufflinks and he gladly borrowed me his personal cufflinks. 

On the third day, I remember I was seated for breakfast and the staff say: "cappuccino and 2 extra shots of espresso sir?" ... Certainly (They know and remember what you like and it is a touch of honor.

And for the last day before I left, I requested Mr. Minh for the chef to make anything special for me of his forte, which is not on the menu.

Then he serve me a special Nasi Goreng with fried Chicken and the most special gift from the hotel is a Hand Crafted Dimsum which are very High in Quality, Tasteful & Elegance. Made by a Li Bai Chef with 30+ Years of Experience. I almost cry eating this, feels like the prawn is dancing in my mouth and I must admit it is a fine culinary experience. Last but not least, to end things off they had my favorite Ice Cream Flavor: Stracciatella

Thank you to Mr. Minh and all the Sheraton Saigon staff for the wonderful service!

reviews.review_text:

Overhyped scoring ending deflated...........
Jul 2023 • Couples
First review i've done on TA, but unfortunately i have to start on a bad review. 

Booked a table on by birthday (friday night) based on the "high scoring reviews" for an early dinner just after they opened. 

On first appearances, restaurant is clean, plenty of staff, bright. Tables and food are assorted neatly. Area is very spacious with lots of seating and from a distance, it appears there are plenty of things on offer.

Now, this is where i will get into my pro's, con's and experience for the evening:

Pro's:

Clean.
Bright.
Spacious
Friendly staff.

Con's:

Lobster's were overcooked (regret not requesting fresh boiled ones).
All beef dishes were very dry (a part from the roast beef).
Distinct lack of MORE seafood options. It was mainly lobster and prawns. No squid? Octopus? FISH?
Distinct lack of MORE meat options. It was mainly dry beef or overcooked duck. No chicken? Lamb?
Sushi counter had only 6 variations of sushi with several having the same ingredients (crab stick).

After navigating around some of the stations, and trying to get my bang for buck, i only ended up having 4 small plates (including desssert) and completely skipped several of them including the "pho", "indian" and what i can only describe as a "diy sandwich/banh mi station".

The food taste was very average at best for everything. Not what i was expecting a 5 star hotel to serve. The noise was very loud due to a corporate meal and felt like i was in a local restaurant with them screaming and shouting for over 30 minutes doing "cheers".

What started out with nice ambience, ended with a very disappointed evening overall. If it was not for the attentive staff and MB offer, i would have scored this review much lower.

Bad food, but good Services
May 2023
On May 12th i had dinner buffet with my family and the food is not actually very good if not it's been the worst dinning experience i've ever had. 

Despite being a 5 star restaurant it has very few dishes. 
The lobster is incredibly tough and chewy as it's been overcook. 
The grill beef is awfully plain and dry, but the ham is way better. 
The flower crab is better, the meat is very sweet and fresh. 
The oysters are the worst of them all, most of them are dead (NOT FRESH AT ALL) so fishy. I threw it up after one bite. 
The peppered green mussles are salty and the rest of the dish there are very plain in compare. 
The only 2 dish that are good is Phở, and Bánh canh

Despite the good desserts, the whole buffet is overall a very awful experience for me and my family.
